art_note: The imagery relies on composited mockups and marketplace-style graphics, lacking the refined atmosphere of a luxury house.
desc_en: A fluid silhouette defined by a deep V-neckline and striking graphic contrast. This midi dress pairs a patterned bodice with a light-falling white skirt. Designed with an elastic waistband to gently accentuate the silhouette and practical front pockets. A versatile piece tailored for everyday wear or relaxed occasions. Each garment is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta fluida definida por un profundo escote en V y un contraste gráfico audaz. Este vestido midi combina una parte superior estampada con una falda blanca de caída ligera. Incorpora una cintura elástica que realza la figura de manera natural y bolsillos frontales funcionales. Una pieza versátil concebida para el día a día o momentos de descanso. Cada prenda se confecciona bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
